ae2_recent_search.configuration.title: AE2 Recent Search
ae2_recent_search.settings.title: Recent Search Settings
ae2_recent_search.settings.history.hint: When the AE2 terminal search field is focused, recent searches are shown below it. Clearing only removes the current player's entries.
ae2_recent_search.settings.click_behavio: When enabled, clicking a history entry immediately applies the search. When disabled, it only fills the search field.
ae2_recent_search.settings.external_sear: When enabled, recent searches also update JEI/REI if AE2 external search sync is enabled.
